author: Zegita
body: Hello once again guys I was banned(this time not for hacks ;) cuz I don't) but for rudeness. See the story goes was that I was being provoked by a bunch of people "you're shit, go away ur nub" etc and so I just retaliated back without me thinking about anyone else. So I was being a bit rude and the server almost got into a whole argument cuz of me.. and I am very sorry for doing this. I am being as honest as I can here and I hope I can be unbanned before tonight as you see I have a scrim I need to attend with my team. Thanks for reading this and I promise this will not happen again :). Thank you for reading and have a nice day.

title: Appeal: Rudeness

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

The moderators involved did the correct thing, as you were clearly being abusive in the chat. You had already received a kick and a warn prior to the temp-ban too. This infraction will not be appealed so please wait until it expires.

Regards,
Mango_
